headline: Transactions: Share of large-home sales falls across all seven metros; small homes overtake in three metros - Finance
summary: Yongqing Realty Group analysed transaction registrations from 2021 to the first half of 2026 in seven major metropolitan areas. The share of large-home sales fell across all seven, with small homes overtaking in three.
why: Housing transaction data reflect buyer demand and affordability, which matter for property developers, lenders and Taiwan's economy.
